lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: we've had an uptick in patients suffering from depression.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: How are you feeling?
I don't have time to be depressed.
Not bad, I guess.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Haha, impressive!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You're lucky to be surrounded by good friends.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You've got a great support group around you,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: so you'll be fine.
What about you, Mary?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I've been pretty swamped myself.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I've also got Pepper to look after, so I can't afford to be depressed.
That's good.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I think so too.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I hope everyone in the world

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: can be content with who they are and with their own lives.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: If you just look around,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: you'll find many people who are willing to help.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: If you ever feel you need someone to talk to,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Pepper and I are just a phone call away.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Just having someone to listen can be a big help! ^^
Okay.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Well, I should be going then.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Pepper is looking for me.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I'll send you a message later.
